params.prompt:
Animate the EXACT faceless shadow creature in the reference, with its face design completely unchanged. The face is a smooth featureless black surface bearing ONLY TWO solid ivory-white slanted paint shapes with tiny white drips. These eye shapes are opaque solid ivory, with NO pupils, NO iris and NO holes. The entire area below the eyes stays featureless black throughout. NO mouth, lips, teeth, nose, red shapes or human facial anatomy may appear at any time.
ACTION: He raises his right gloved hand beside his right temple, keeps the index finger extended and the other fingers curled, and physically rotates the hand so the fingertip moves in two small circles next to the hood. This is the familiar cheeky 'crazy' hand gesture, performed with a real glove, NOT drawing anything. The fingertip touches only empty air. There is NO drawn circle, NO motion trail, NO icon, NO glowing line, NO symbol, NO writing. A small head tilt supports the gesture, with the original solid ivory eyes unchanged. Lower the hand and return to the original neutral pose. Keep feet planted and anatomy natural.
Only the character moves. Perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00FF00 digital background and invisible floor remain unchanged, including actual gaps between limbs. Neutral white subject lighting independent of the plate, no green reflections, fringe, rim light, glow, gradients or cast background shadows. Opaque clothes and eyes remain opaque; crisp antialiased silhouette without motion blur.
Locked full-body camera, scale, exposure and white balance. Keep the ENTIRE character, all fingers, boots and the complete movement envelope fully inside EVERY frame with generous empty margins. No zoom, camera movement, approach toward camera, cropping or scene changes.
One seamless eight-second loop. Start and finish in the exact supplied neutral pose, original position, scale, eye shape and lighting. Return through real physical motion and smoothly settle to matching velocity at the seam; no cuts, dissolve or reverse playback. Silent.
